subtitle: Browse the internet or LAN via this host. Targets never see your desktop browser identity.
modeHint: Internet blocks private IPs; Intranet allows LAN targets. Both block cloud metadata.
emptyBody: Enter a URL. DNS, TLS, and egress use this server — not your browser. Cookies stay in a server-side jar.
modeSwitchHint: Switching mode opens a new session and clears cookies.
downloadHint: Non-HTML response — open content frame or navigate again.
engineSwitchHint: Switching engine opens a new session.
needChrome: Real browser needs system Chrome/Chromium (or set YSK_HOST_BROWSE_CHROME). Using proxy otherwise.
needChromeFallback: Chrome unavailable — switched to proxy engine.
softwareNeeded: Chromium / Chrome required for real browser engine
softwareHint: One-click installs distro Chromium via apt. Google Chrome binary is also detected if already present. Requires root + YSK_EXECUTE=1.
settingsIntro: These panel settings override process environment variables for Host Browse.
envHintsTitle: Process env (read-only; panel settings take precedence when set)

err.LIVE_NO_FRAME: Stream timed out: no frames received. Reconnect or retry navigation.
err.LIVE_WS_FAIL: Live connection failed. Reconnect the stream.
err.BOT_CHALLENGE: Target may require human verification or block automation. Complete the challenge on-screen if shown.
err.CHROME_LAUNCH: Could not start host Chromium. Check install and no-sandbox settings.

mediaNote: Real browser: video is streamed; audio is not yet bridged to the panel (phase 2).
isolationNote: Real browser creates an ephemeral Linux user for Chrome; leaving the page or idle timeout destroys that user.
